workhorse_s.description: Idle seconds before the workhorse local model is unloaded.

digest_interval_days.description: Days between memory digests presented for review.

project.description: Token budget for project-scope memory injected into a run's context.

user.description: Token budget for user-scope memory injected into a run's context.

worker_overlay.title: Injection budget — worker overlay

value_divergence_alarm.description: Alarm threshold for divergence between the platform's meter and the provider's reported usage.

depth_cap.description: Maximum helper nesting depth; raising the ceiling past 2 is a deliberate operator bounds change, never routine.

helper_retry_limit.description: How many times one failed helper is retried before the failure surfaces.

helper_turns.description: Turn budget one helper gets before it must report; automation may move this within the operator's bounds.

bg_admit_stop.description: Consumption-pressure level past which background work stops being admitted.

drain_grace.description: How long in-flight runs may keep working after maintenance mode starts before they are parked at their last checkpoint.

values.title: Distillation threshold
values.help: How many related lessons accumulate before distillation into a single entry is proposed.

values.title: Injection budget — house scope
values.help: Token budget for house-scope memory injected into a run's context.

values.title: Injection budget — project scope
values.help: Token budget for project-scope memory injected into a run's context.

values.title: Injection budget — user scope
values.help: Token budget for user-scope memory injected into a run's context.

values.title: Injection budget — worker overlay
values.help: Token budget for worker-overlay memory; the scope activates at v1.

values.title: Vector gate — miss-rate trigger
values.help: Pre-registered retrieval miss rate that, once exceeded, opens the vector-search gate; evaluated only after the 15.3 benchmark gate.

values.title: Vector gate — corpus-size trigger
values.help: Pre-registered corpus size that, once exceeded, opens the vector-search gate.

values.title: Cache-read pressure weight
values.help: How strongly cache reads count into consumption pressure; labeled assumed until the provider publishes quota semantics.
values.ratified_by: G1 Def.10 (consumer S05; dedup S18.4 R3)

values.title: Background admission stop
values.help: Consumption-pressure level past which background work stops being admitted.

values.title: Background window fraction
values.help: Fraction of a subscription window background work may consume; labeled assumed.

values.title: Meter divergence alarm
values.help: Alarm threshold for divergence between the platform's meter and the provider's reported usage.

values.title: Limit-event retry cap
values.help: Maximum retries after a provider limit event before the run parks.

values.title: Retry budget ratio
values.help: Fraction of a run's budget retries may consume.

values.title: Limit probe interval cap
values.help: Ceiling on the backoff between probes of a closed provider window.

values.title: Missed-slot default
values.help: What a schedule slot missed during suspend does by default; the user-facing schedule surface arrives at v1.

values.title: Background CPU weight
values.help: systemd CPUWeight for the background slice: idle, or an integer weight from 1 to 10000.

values.title: Egress deny list
values.help: CIDRs sandboxed runs may never reach; the cloud-metadata address is a non-removable floor.

values.title: Block outbound DoH
values.help: Block DNS-over-HTTPS from sandboxes so egress policy cannot be tunneled around; turning this off requires a recorded reason.

values.title: Package-registry allowlist
values.help: Curated package-registry and CDN hosts C2-confined runs may fetch from (the Copilot/Codex-preset shape; npm/pypi/crates/apt/go/maven/nuget/rubygems). The concrete curated preset is materialized by the S11 sandbox packet; consumers treat an empty list as preset-not-installed. Data, like the price table.

values.title: Model egress TLS termination
values.help: Terminate TLS on model egress per lane; off means that lane falls back to pattern-2 scoped egress.

values.title: Fast-tier idle TTL
values.help: Idle seconds before the fast-tier local model is unloaded and its VRAM returns to zero.

values.title: Workhorse idle TTL
values.help: Idle seconds before the workhorse local model is unloaded.

values.title: eGPU idle TTL
values.help: Idle seconds before an eGPU-pool model is unloaded; dormant until the eGPU pool is enrolled.

values.title: VRAM guard band
values.help: VRAM headroom the GPU broker keeps free when admitting a model load.

values.title: Unload termination grace
values.help: Seconds a local-model backend gets to exit cleanly before it is killed on unload.

values.title: GameMode hook
values.help: Pause local-lane admissions and eager-unload models when GameMode reports a game session.

values.title: GPU admission on battery
values.help: Whether GPU model loads are admitted while the host runs on battery.

values.title: Batch work on AC only
values.help: Restrict local batch workloads to when the host is on mains power.

values.title: Sandbox logprobs exposure
values.help: Whether sandboxed callers of the local-inference bridge may request logprobs (per-template; off reduces side channels).

values.title: Local model re-evaluation cadence
values.help: Months between re-evaluations of the local model set against current releases.

values.title: Duty-alias map
values.help: Maps each platform duty alias to its serving local model or seat (S12.3/S12.4); changes land only through the S12.10 swap gate.

values.title: Review anchor drift tolerance
values.help: How many lines a review comment's anchor may drift before it detaches (the carried N15 behavior).

values.title: Snapshot interval
values.help: How often the durable-set snapshot pipeline runs.

values.title: Snapshots kept
values.help: How many snapshots the rotation keeps.

values.title: Snapshot repo rotation
values.help: Months before the snapshot repository is rotated.

values.title: Restore drill interval
values.help: Months between scheduled verified-restore drills (distinct from the escalation drill, S18.4 R6).

values.title: Preview idle stop
values.help: Idle time before a running preview is stopped and its port returns to the pool.

values.title: Concurrent previews
values.help: Maximum previews running at once.

values.title: SSE keepalive interval
values.help: Comment-frame keepalive cadence on the one SSE endpoint so idle proxies never drop the stream.

values.title: Loop-repeat trigger
values.help: How many near-identical repeats of the same action trip the loop watchdog.

values.title: Ping-pong trigger
values.help: How many alternating A/B cycles trip the ping-pong watchdog.

values.title: Error-loop trigger
values.help: How many identical errors in a row trip the error-loop watchdog.

values.title: Silence budgets by run type
values.help: Per-run-type silence budgets in seconds before the silence watchdog flags; empty entries fall back to the recovery dead-after seed until the bring-up calibration (TBD-BRINGUP) fills them.
values.ratified_by: G2 Def.10 (map key ⚙ watchdog.silence_budget.<run_type>; seed = recovery.dead_after)

values.title: Spend spike trigger
values.help: Multiple of the trailing-14-day median spend that trips the spend watchdog.

values.title: Spend watchdog arming period
values.help: Days of history required before the spend watchdog arms.

values.title: Flag-now target rate
values.help: Target daily rate of immediate watchdog flags used to judge threshold health.

values.title: Suppressions before retune
values.help: How many operator suppressions of the same flag propose a threshold retune; the retune lands as a proposal card, never an auto-move.

values.title: Watchlist fetch-fail streak
values.help: Consecutive failed fetch cycles before a watchlist source is flagged.

values.title: Auth canary interval
values.help: Cadence of the provider auth-revocation canary (daily by default; between four times daily and weekly).
values.ratified_by: G1 Def.3 set; P-T17-1; S18.4 R5

values.title: Behavioral canary interval
values.help: Cadence of the behavioral drift canary (weekly by default; between daily and monthly).

values.title: Trace compaction horizon
values.help: Months of full event payloads kept before compaction; per person.

values.title: Eval sweep interval
values.help: Months between full regression-eval sweeps.

values.title: Benchmark sampling rates
values.help: Percent of eligible tasks sampled into the benchmark per phase; uniformity is frozen and registered values change only via a re-registration commit (BENCH-REG §4.1; S18.4 R9).

values.title: Frontend dependency pass interval
values.help: Days between SPA dependency passes; co-scheduled with the components.lock review (S18.4 R7).

values.title: Dependency pass cadence
values.help: Months between quarterly passes over every components.lock entry.

values.title: Default abandonment horizon
values.help: Months of upstream inactivity that propose executing an entry's funeral plan; overridable per entry in components.lock.

values.title: Price data staleness horizon
values.help: Days without upstream price-table updates, while providers reprice, before the fallback source is proposed.

registered_absent: the registered-value block could not be read: not_implemented: the fixture world serves the benchmark READS the committed bodies need; its acts are driven by the package's own battery
editable_reason: settings are operator-edited (S18.1): the registry records an operator or an automation actor and admits no member kind, so a member's own per-user override is set for them by the operator (D10)
